main.summary: Durable manifest describing a staged segmented transfer session.

field.name: ManifestFileName
field.summary: Conventional file name for the persisted manifest JSON document.

field.name: ObjectFileName
field.summary: Conventional file name for the staged serialized object payload.

field.name: StreamFileName
field.summary: Conventional file name for the staged sparse stream payload.

property.name: SourceSessionID
property.summary: Optional source session identifier for follower read sessions.

property.name: ObjectSHA512
property.summary: SHA-512 of the serialized object payload.

property.name: StreamSHA512
property.summary: SHA-512 of the complete stream payload.

method.name: Validate
method.summary: Determine whether the manifest content is internally valid.
method.returns: True when the manifest is valid.

method.name: NormalizeRanges
method.summary: Return a manifest whose realized ranges are sorted and merged.

method.name: GetRealizedBytes
method.summary: Compute the total realized byte count represented by the manifest ranges.

method.name: GetMissingRanges
method.summary: Compute the currently missing byte ranges for the declared stream length.

method.name: HasFullCoverage
method.summary: Determine whether the manifest ranges fully cover the declared stream length.
method.returns: True when full logical coverage exists.

method.name: CanReadRange
method.summary: Determine whether a fully realized range may be read from the staged stream.
method.returns: True when the range is fully realized.

method.name: CanWriteRange
method.summary: Determine whether a range is within the declared stream bounds.
method.returns: True when the range is within bounds.

method.name: ToState
method.summary: Materialize a transfer state view from the manifest.

method.name: Touch
method.summary: Return a manifest with updated timestamp and incremented state version.
method.param: True to clear any fault message.

method.name: WithStatus
method.summary: Return a manifest with an updated status, fault message, timestamp, and incremented state version.

method.name: WithAddedRange
method.summary: Return a manifest with an additional realized range merged into persisted coverage.

method.name: Serialize
method.summary: Serialize the manifest to UTF-8 JSON bytes.

method.name: Save
method.summary: Persist the manifest to a file path.
method.returns: True when the manifest was written successfully.

method.name: Parse
method.summary: Parse a manifest from JSON text.
method.returns: Parsed manifest when successful; otherwise null.

method.name: Deserialize
method.summary: Parse a manifest from UTF-8 JSON bytes.
method.returns: Parsed manifest when successful; otherwise null.

method.name: TryParse
method.summary: Attempt to parse a manifest from JSON text.

method.name: Load
method.summary: Load a manifest from a file path.
method.returns: Loaded manifest when successful; otherwise null.

method.name: ToString
method.summary: Serialize the manifest to JSON text.

method.name: ValidateObjectHash
method.summary: Determine whether a SHA-512 hash buffer has the expected length.
method.returns: True when the buffer length matches SHA-512 output.

method.name: ValidateStreamHash
method.summary: Determine whether a SHA-512 hash buffer has the expected length for a given stream length.
method.returns: True when the buffer length matches SHA-512 output for the given stream length.

method.name: NormalizeRangesCore
method.summary: Sort, validate, and merge realized ranges into canonical half-open coverage.

method.name: GetMissingRangesCore
method.summary: Compute the missing ranges within the declared stream length from canonical realized ranges.

method.name: GetRealizedBytesCore
method.summary: Compute the total realized byte count from canonical realized ranges.

method.name: AreRangesWithinStreamLengthCore
method.summary: Determine whether all canonical realized ranges fall within the declared stream length.
method.returns: True when all realized ranges are within bounds.

method.name: EnumerateRangesWithOneMore
method.summary: Enumerate an existing range sequence followed by one additional range.
